paragraphs: Leo and May are on a train. Grandma sits next to them. May has a paper and a pen. The paper has a list with boxes. "Let's play a game," says May. "I ask a question, and you answer." "Then you ask me." "Do you understand?" "Yes!" says Leo.

"What is your favorite color?" asks May. "Green," says Leo. "And you?" "Blue," says May. "What is your favorite animal?" asks Leo. "A giraffe," says May. "And you?" "A frog!" says Leo. "Jump, jump, jump!" May smiles. Then she looks at the window. "What is your favorite sport?" asks May. "Football," says Leo. "And you?" "Tennis," says May.

"What is your favorite food?" asks May. "Mango," says Leo. "Mango is my favorite too!" says May. "We tick it!" says Leo. May ticks the box on the paper. Grandma smiles at them. "Tell me, children," says Grandma. "What is your favorite song?" "The frog song!" says Leo. May says, "I like the train song." They all sing, and the train goes on.
text.summary: Leo and May ride a train with Grandma. They ask each other about favorite colors, animals, and food, and they tick the same answers.
